title: Secrets and credentials around the model

videos.script: Tarefa's assistant runs on keys. One for the model provider, one for payments, and a password for the orders database. {{title}} A scanner reads every file for something shaped like a key. It finds five in six files, and it never prints one whole. {{scan}} The same payments key is written in two places, the code and the prompt. {{twice}} A key in a prompt is text the model can repeat, and it lands in every log of every prompt. So the model holds no credential at all. The tool that needs one holds it. {{model}} An exception is written down, with a reason, and pinned to one value. {{allow}} Then the inventory. Every key is checked for where it lives, what it may do, and how old it is. The payments key fails all three. {{inventory}} And when a key leaks, deleting the line is not the fix. Rotating the key is. {{rotate}}
